title: Top 3 Recruiting Companies in Springfield MA — Verified 2026
excerpt: Only three recruiting companies in Springfield, MA passed independent verification for 2026 — an honest count from a consolidating market.
author: Umaira Liaquat
content:
Last updated: September 2026

Search for the top recruiting companies in Springfield, MA and the results thin out fast. Nearly twenty names came up in the initial pass through Google Business Profile, the Better Business Bureau, Dun & Bradstreet, and the Massachusetts Staffing Association's own member directory. Only three had a real, independently verifiable office inside Springfield city limits and cleared every check this series runs. That's not a padded "Top 5" trimmed down for a clean headline — it's the honest count.

The short list has a real explanation, and it's more useful to a Springfield employer than pretending otherwise: several of the city's historically independent staffing firms have been bought out by larger, out-of-state operators over the past few years. Two of the three companies below are still physically headquartered in Springfield, run by local leadership, in offices they've held for decades — but one of them now operates as a division of a Worcester-based parent, and that ownership change is disclosed plainly in its profile rather than glossed over. Consolidation, not a lack of hiring demand, is why this list is short.

Why Springfield's Recruiting Market Is Different

Springfield anchors the Pioneer Valley, the stretch of Western Massachusetts that runs along the Connecticut River from the Vermont border down through Springfield and into Connecticut. It's a genuinely distinct labor market from Boston's, built on a mix of advanced manufacturing left over from the region's industrial history, healthcare systems that serve the whole Western Mass region, logistics tied to the I-91 corridor, and a service economy anchored by Springfield itself as the region's largest city.

The Pioneer Valley Planning Commission's own regional labor market blueprint (cited in full below) projects the staffing agencies industry itself growing by roughly 26% in the near term across the region, with Healthcare & Social Assistance and Advanced Manufacturing both flagged as priority sectors for workforce investment. That's a market with real hiring demand behind it — which makes the thinness of this list more notable, not less.

Here's the structural reason for it. Several of Springfield's own, locally founded staffing firms have been absorbed by out-of-state consolidators in recent years rather than staying independent. United Personnel, founded right in Springfield in 1984, was acquired in 2021 by Masis Staffing Solutions, headquartered forty-five minutes east in Worcester. Johnson & Hill Staffing, founded on State Street in Springfield in 1995, is now part of Boston-based KNF&T Staffing Resources. Both are still real, physically staffed operations — they're just no longer independent Springfield companies, which is a different thing than not existing at all. The Federal Reserve Bank of Boston's regional labor-market data for Massachusetts tracks this kind of roll-up consolidation across the state's smaller metro labor markets, and Springfield's staffing sector shows the same pattern other mid-size Massachusetts cities have seen: fewer standalone independents, more branch offices and acquired divisions.

That's the real story behind this list. It isn't that Springfield employers have nowhere to turn — it's that what used to be a broader bench of independent local agencies has narrowed through acquisition, leaving three names that actually clear a hand-verification standard against a field of national landing pages, satellite offices in other municipalities, and one unresolved directory mix-up.

1. Summit Careers Inc.

Summit Careers Inc. has run from 85 B Mill St in Springfield since the late 1980s — the BBB's own file dates it to 1988, while a secondary source puts it a year later at 1989, so this piece notes "founded in the late 1980s" rather than picking one year as settled fact. It's the strongest-verified entry on this list by a wide margin: its own website, a BBB profile, Yelp, Glassdoor, a Facebook business page, and a ZoomInfo listing all independently confirm the same Springfield address and operation, well past the two-source minimum this series requires.

Summit places direct-hire, contract, and payroll-only staff across precision manufacturing, warehousing and distribution, administrative roles, education, professional trades, and medical and dental offices, and also offers HR consulting alongside placement. It carries a 5.0 rating on Glassdoor from 7 reviews — worth flagging as a self-reported, platform-tallied figure rather than an independently audited score, and a small sample size at that. Beyond Springfield, Summit also runs satellite offices in Hartford, CT, Westerly, RI, and Cranston, RI, but Springfield is where the company was founded and remains its primary location, not a branch of an out-of-state parent.

Best fit for: a Springfield-area manufacturer, warehouse, school, or medical office that wants one locally founded firm covering direct hire, contract staffing, and payrolling under one roof.

Pricing: not published; expect a markup on the hourly bill rate for contract and payrolled staff, and a placement fee for direct hire.

2. Elite Staffing Services Inc.

Elite Staffing Services Inc. has operated from 525 Belmont Ave in Springfield since 2002, according to Dun & Bradstreet's own filing, which lists the business under "Help Supply Services." Four independent sources — Yelp, Dun & Bradstreet, MerchantCircle, and the CMac.ws employment-agencies directory — all agree on the same name, address, and phone number, (413) 205-1243, well past this series' two-source minimum even without a company-owned website in the mix.

That last point needs to be said plainly: no independent company website could be found for this business, and contact is phone-only. That's genuinely unusual for an active staffing firm in 2026, which is exactly why this entry is illustrated with a directory listing screenshot instead of a homepage — there simply isn't a homepage to show. It's also worth being explicit about a name collision this series ran into during research: this Springfield, MA business is not the same company as Elite Staffing Inc, the Chicago-headquartered national firm that markets itself as part of a 2,000-plus-agency staffing alliance. That's a separate, unrelated organization with a similar name; the Elite Staffing Services profiled here is a distinct, independently listed Springfield business.

Best fit for: a Springfield employer with light-industrial or general staffing needs who's comfortable working with a phone-only local operation rather than requiring an online quote or portal.

Pricing: not published; contact the office directly at (413) 205-1243 for a bill-rate quote.

3. United Personnel

United Personnel was founded in Springfield in 1984 and has run from 289 Bridge Street ever since, connecting more than 1,000 people to jobs annually across Western Massachusetts by its own count — a figure worth flagging as self-reported rather than independently audited, though it's consistent with the company's long regional footprint. It places administrative and professional staff, finance roles, light-industrial and manufacturing workers, medical-office staff, and hospitality workers, and its presence is confirmed through its own company site, LinkedIn, Yelp, Yellow Pages, and its member listing with the Massachusetts Staffing Association.

Two disclosures belong here, both handled the same way this series has disclosed real-office-but-outside-ownership cases in other cities. First, on May 18, 2021, United Personnel was acquired by Masis Staffing Solutions, headquartered in Worcester, MA — confirmed via Worcester Business Journal's coverage of the deal at the time. United Personnel now operates as a division of Masis rather than as an independent company, though it kept its original Springfield office and its local president, Tricia Canavan, stayed on to run it. Second, during the research for this piece, unitedpersonnel.com did not respond to repeated connection attempts — a genuine timeout confirmed across headless-browser, direct HTTP, and DNS-level checks, not a bot block or a 403. Rather than force a broken-link screenshot or drop a verified 1984 Springfield business over a temporary site outage, this profile uses a screenshot of the company's current Massachusetts Staffing Association member listing instead, which independently confirms the same Springfield HQ, founding year, and ownership details cited above.

Best fit for: a Western Massachusetts employer that wants a firm with four decades of Springfield roots, now backed by a larger regional staffing group's resources.

Pricing: not published; markup on the hourly bill rate for temp and temp-to-hire, placement fee for direct hire.

How This List Was Verified (and Why It's Only Three)

Every candidate had to clear the same bar this series applies everywhere: a real, staffed office physically inside Springfield city limits, independently confirmed through at least two of Google Business Profile, the Better Business Bureau, Dun & Bradstreet, the Massachusetts Staffing Association's member directory, or the company's own site, plus a working point of contact that matched the location claim. Ownership was then recorded honestly — independently headquartered, or a branch/division with its parent named — because a real branch with disclosed ownership is genuinely useful to a Springfield employer, and a landing page or a satellite mention is not. Roughly twenty candidates were reviewed against that bar; three cleared it.

Several well-known names turned out to be real offices, but branches of firms headquartered elsewhere rather than local businesses. Robert Half keeps an office at One Monarch Place, but it's a branch of a multibillion-dollar firm headquartered in San Ramon, California, not a Springfield-based company. J. Morrissey & Co. and KNF&T Staffing both maintain a real suite at 1391 Main St, but their ownership and headquarters sit in Windsor, CT, near Hartford. Johnson & Hill Staffing, mentioned above in the consolidation discussion, was genuinely founded in Springfield in 1995 but has since been absorbed into Boston-headquartered KNF&T — a real history, but no longer an independent local operation. Complete Labor & Staffing is headquartered in Manchester, NH, with no independent Springfield ownership behind its local presence.

A cluster of names failed on address technicalities rather than ownership. Insight Global, headquartered in Atlanta, GA, publishes only a toll-free number with no distinct physical Springfield address found anywhere. Atlantic Group is a national, New York-based firm with no verifiable independent Springfield office beyond a marketing landing page. TAG MedStaffing, headquartered in New York City, runs one of dozens of near-identical templated city landing pages with no distinct physical address behind the Springfield version. FIT Staffing has a real office, but it's actually headquartered in Northampton, MA, not Springfield, despite what a casual search might suggest. Lordstone Corporation has no real Springfield office at all; its actual locations are in Fort Myers, FL, and Gladstone, MI.

A separate group of agencies turned out to be located in West Springfield, MA — a distinct municipality across the Connecticut River, not Springfield proper, and a mix-up this series treats the same way it treats any neighboring-city bleed. Pascoe Workforce Solutions, Spherion, Aerotek, CoWorx, and Advantage Staffing Associates all fall into this category: real offices, real staffing operations, just not inside Springfield's own city limits.

Two names came up that aren't recruiting or staffing agencies at all, despite surfacing in an initial "Springfield MA staffing" search. New England Business Associates (NEBA) is a real Springfield nonprofit, but it's a vocational-rehabilitation organization serving people with developmental disabilities, not a commercial recruiting business. HomeCare Hands runs a real Springfield office too, but it directly employs caregivers to provide home-care services to clients, rather than placing candidates with outside employers the way a staffing agency does.

The remaining candidates failed on dead ends or unresolved records. Office Team, a Robert Half brand, has confirmed closed as of mid-2026. Expert Staffing Partners Inc. turned up only one source, a BBB listing that itself carries a BBB alert for misuse of the BBB name and logo — and the company's own domain has expired and is now squatted by an unrelated gambling site, an explicit exclusion trigger this series has flagged before. Workforce Staffing Agency Inc., listed at 222 Carew St in several directories, was the hardest case: the website those same directories point to actually declares a Northampton, MA address and ties to a differently named entity, "Golden Years Staffing." Whether that's a genuine Springfield branch with a directory error, or a directory listing that's simply wrong, couldn't be resolved either way, so it was excluded as unresolved rather than guessed at — consistent with this series' standard of never padding a list with a candidate that can't be pinned down cleanly.

What's left is Summit Careers, Elite Staffing Services, and United Personnel: two independently headquartered Springfield businesses and one long-running Springfield original now operating as a disclosed division of a Worcester-based parent. That's the honest count this market produces once every candidate is actually checked rather than assumed.

How These 3 Companies Compare

  • Most independently verified: Summit Careers Inc., confirmed across its own site, BBB, Yelp, Glassdoor, Facebook, and ZoomInfo — well above the two-source minimum.
  • Longest continuous Springfield address without an acquisition: Elite Staffing Services Inc., at 525 Belmont Ave since 2002, still independently run.
  • Deepest local history: United Personnel, founded in Springfield in 1984, now a disclosed division of Worcester-based Masis Staffing Solutions.
  • Only entry without a company website: Elite Staffing Services Inc. — verified instead through four independent directory sources.
  • Broadest specialty range: Summit Careers, spanning manufacturing, warehousing, administrative, education, trades, and medical/dental placements.

What to Check Before Signing With Any of Them

  • Visit or call the Springfield address directly — roughly seventeen of the candidates reviewed for this piece turned out to have no genuine Springfield office at all
  • Ask for the markup percentage or placement fee in writing — none of the three publish a rate card
  • Confirm current ownership before you sign — United Personnel now operates as a division of Masis Staffing Solutions, and a directory listing can lag an acquisition by years
  • Don't confuse Elite Staffing Services Inc. with the similarly named Chicago-based national firm — they are unrelated companies
  • Get temp-to-hire conversion terms up front — this is where surprise fees usually surface later, regardless of which agency you pick
  • If a company's website won't load, call before writing it off — this research found a genuinely 40-year-old Springfield business whose own domain was temporarily unreachable, not defunct

The Bottom Line

Springfield's recruiting market is real and growing — the Pioneer Valley Planning Commission's Labor Market Blueprint 2024–2025 projects roughly 26% near-term growth in the staffing industry itself — but the independent local bench has narrowed through consolidation, not through a lack of demand. Summit Careers is the most thoroughly verified, independently run option with the broadest specialty range. Elite Staffing Services is a genuine, independently operated local business, verified through directories rather than a company site. United Personnel carries the deepest Springfield roots of the three, now operating transparently as a division of Worcester-based Masis Staffing Solutions rather than as a fully independent company.

Whichever you choose, the diligence is the same: confirm the current address and ownership, get the markup or placement fee in writing, and don't assume a landing page with "Springfield" in the URL means an actual local office stands behind it.

What are the top recruiting companies in Springfield, MA?

Three agencies passed independent verification for 2026: Summit Careers Inc., Elite Staffing Services Inc., and United Personnel. Summit Careers and Elite Staffing Services are independently run Springfield businesses; United Personnel was founded in Springfield in 1984 and now operates as a disclosed division of Worcester-based Masis Staffing Solutions.

Why does this list only have three companies on it?

Because that's what independent verification turned up. Roughly twenty candidates were checked against a real, staffed Springfield office and at least two independent confirming sources. Most failed — branches of firms headquartered elsewhere, agencies actually located in neighboring West Springfield, a nonprofit and a home-care provider mistaken for staffing agencies, one dead domain squatted by a gambling site, and one unresolved directory mix-up. Padding the list with any of those would be less useful to a Springfield employer than an honest count.

Why has Springfield's recruiting market gotten smaller?

Consolidation, not falling demand. United Personnel, founded in Springfield in 1984, was acquired by Worcester-based Masis Staffing Solutions in 2021. Johnson & Hill Staffing, founded in Springfield in 1995, is now part of Boston-based KNF&T Staffing Resources. Both firms still operate real offices; they're simply no longer independent Springfield companies. Meanwhile the Pioneer Valley Planning Commission projects the region's staffing industry growing roughly 26% in the near term, so the shrinking list reflects a roll-up trend, not a shrinking market.

Is United Personnel still based in Springfield?

Yes. It kept its original office at 289 Bridge Street and its local president, Tricia Canavan, after being acquired by Masis Staffing Solutions in 2021. The office and local leadership are unchanged; the ownership and corporate structure are not, and United Personnel now operates as a division of Masis rather than as a standalone company.

Does Elite Staffing Services Inc. have a website?

No independent company website could be found for this Springfield business during verification, which is unusual for an active staffing firm in 2026. It's still independently confirmed through four sources — Yelp, Dun & Bradstreet, MerchantCircle, and the CMac.ws employment-agencies directory — and reachable by phone at (413) 205-1243. This profile uses a directory listing screenshot rather than a homepage screenshot for that reason.

Is Elite Staffing Services Inc. the same company as Elite Staffing Inc. in Chicago?

No. Elite Staffing Inc. is a Chicago-headquartered national firm that markets itself as part of a staffing alliance with more than 2,000 member agencies. The Elite Staffing Services Inc. profiled here is a separate, independently listed Springfield, MA business at 525 Belmont Ave with no confirmed corporate connection to the Chicago firm.

Why isn't Robert Half on this list?

Robert Half has a real office at One Monarch Place in Springfield, but it's a branch of a multibillion-dollar national firm headquartered in San Ramon, California. This series distinguishes locally headquartered businesses and disclosed local divisions from branch offices of large national corporations, and a branch of a firm that size didn't fit alongside the three independently verified entries here.

What happened to Expert Staffing Partners Inc.?

Only one source could confirm it at all — a BBB listing that itself carries a BBB alert for misuse of the BBB name and logo. Its own domain has since expired and is now squatted by an unrelated online gambling site, which this series treats as a clear exclusion trigger regardless of how the original business once operated.

Why aren't Spherion, Aerotek, and CoWorx on this list?

Their local offices are located in West Springfield, MA, which is a separate municipality across the Connecticut River from Springfield proper, not a neighborhood within Springfield itself. This series holds a strict city-limits standard, so agencies genuinely based in a neighboring town are excluded even when they're a short drive away.

How much do staffing agencies in Springfield, MA charge?

None of the three publish rate cards. Temp and contract staffing is typically priced as a markup on the worker's hourly bill rate, and direct hire as a percentage placement fee. Ask each agency for the exact figure in writing, along with temp-to-hire conversion terms, before signing.

How do I confirm a Springfield staffing agency actually has a local office?

Cross-check the exact street address against Google Business Profile, the Better Business Bureau, Dun & Bradstreet, and, where relevant, the Massachusetts Staffing Association's member directory. This research found agencies whose real offices sat in a neighboring municipality, one whose parent company was headquartered out of state, and one whose domain had been taken over by an unrelated site entirely.

What industries drive staffing demand in Springfield, MA?

Advanced manufacturing and healthcare & social assistance are both flagged as priority growth sectors in the Pioneer Valley Planning Commission's regional labor market blueprint, alongside logistics tied to the I-91 corridor and Springfield's role as Western Massachusetts's largest city and regional service hub.
